title: Meta's new VR glasses and AI glasses: Hands-on
excerpt: We go hands-on with Meta's new VR glasses and explore what's next for its AI-powered glasses.
content_html:
Muse AI on Meta glasses? Hearing enhancement? VR glasses that run Quest games? Camera-free glasses? All that and more to talk about, but very little on privacy.

Read more about Meta’s new glasses and Meta Connect 2026: Everything announced at Meta Connect 2026
